questions.text: Which feature ensures that a smart contract executes the same way for every participant?
options: The contract runs on a single server
The code is deterministic and transparent on the blockchain
Developers can adjust outcomes based on user status
Users must sign paperwork before execution
questions.explanation: The narration describes execution as deterministic and transparent so rules apply equally to all.

questions.text: What is the purpose of reviewing token approval prompts before confirming a transaction?
options: To increase the speed of the transaction
To ensure the contract can only spend the amount you intend
To share your private key with the dApp
questions.explanation: The narration advises setting a custom allowance matching only what you intend to trade.

questions.text: True or false: An audit report that identifies a critical vulnerability which remains unfixed means the contract is safe to use.
questions.explanation: The narration says a critical issue where developers have not fixed it makes the contract a no-go zone.

questions.text: What does the presence of emergency keys without a timelock indicate about a protocol?
options: It proves the protocol is fully decentralized
It gives creators instant control to pause trading or withdraw reserves
It eliminates the need for audits
It automatically distributes fees to participants
questions.explanation: The narration states such a backdoor key means you are trusting a stranger, not using a decentralized protocol.
